recipes.name: Deconstructed Sushi Bowl with Sweet Sesame Dressing
instructions: In a medium pot, bring the rice and water to a boil*. Then reduce to a simmer, partially cover with a lid, and cook for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, make the dressing. Add all the ingredients to a jar and mix well.
When the rice is cooked, remove the pot from the heat, cover with a lid, and let rest for 5 minutes.
Add the rice to some bowls. Top with the fruit and veggies. Add the edamame and wakame salad, and drizzle over the dressing. Garnish and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † If unable to soak ahead of time, cook according to the package instructions. * If unable to soak the rice ahead of time, increase the water and cooking time.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. Store the sauce separately for freshness.
